prompt:
We just inherited the payments codebase from the team that was let go last quarter, and we have a production migration review with the CTO in 5 days. Nobody on our team knows this system — we have no documentation, no onboarding notes, nothing.

I need you to dig through the code under /workspace and produce a structured technical briefing that our engineering lead can use to run the migration review meeting. The output should be a single Markdown file named `codebase_report.md`.

Make sure the briefing is actually useful for the meeting — highlight the biggest problems and risks, tell us who owns what, what needs to happen before we go live, and what we do if the primary plan falls apart. It should be concrete enough that someone can walk into the meeting and immediately start assigning tasks.
